card.title: How To Fix iPhone 8 Stuck In DFU Mode. Error 4014

source.title: How To Fix iPhone 8 Stuck In DFU Mode. Error 4014

claims.statement: iPhone 8 stuck in DFU with error 4014 (3uTools ~19%) usually means NAND not detected: check NAND caps for shorts, otherwise read the NAND on a JC P13; unreadable = replace, readable = reball and refit.

procedure: Check capacitors around NAND for shorts.
Pull NAND and test on JC P13.
